answer: Farming becomes a dune bet on surviving 69 epochs of grading, and every river settlement recomputes the quill schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 69 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 26 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
